visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men are seated against a vibrant graffiti-covered wall. The man on the left wears a white t-shirt and white gloves, looking into a black bag held by the man in the center. The center man wears a white t-shirt, a black 'H' cap, and dark sunglasses. The man on the right wears a patterned shirt and a blue cap. (2) The gloved man pulls out several cans of Tiger Beer from the bag, causing surprise and laughter. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting an outdoor or semi-covered urban space. (3) The scene shifts as they open a teal and yellow backpack. The gloved man retrieves a metallic skateboard tool and then a large grey block of wax. The camera uses medium close-ups to focus on the objects. (4) A close-up shows a hand in a white glove rubbing the grey wax block along a metallic railing inside what looks like a skate park or warehouse. (5) The group continues their interview. Graphical overlays appear, including a man in a bright pink suit and yellow text boxes. The men gesture frequently while speaking, maintaining a humorous and energetic atmosphere.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Gear reveal -> Function explanation -> Origin story.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain through a humorous street interview with skateboarders, highlighting the contrast between their 'tough' skater image and the surprising amount of beer in their bags, while also explaining the technical use of skate wax and sharing funny backstories.
